I’m not able to make the API call for you, but I can walk you through how to do it yourself.

**VirusTotal API – Add a Comment**

Endpoint (v3):  
```
POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/comments?resource=192.168.1.1
```

Headers  
```
x-apikey: ABC321
Content-Type: application/json
```

Body (the JSON you supplied)  
```json
{
  "type": "comment",
  "attributes": {
    "text": "Confirmed #malware"
  }
}
```

**Example using `curl`**

```bash
curl -X POST "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/comments?resource=192.168.1.1" \
     -H "x-apikey: ABC321" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"type":"comment","attributes":{"text":"Confirmed #malware"}}'
```

**Example using Python (`requests`)**

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/comments?resource=192.168.1.1"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "ABC321",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
payload = {
    "type": "comment",
    "attributes": {
        "text": "Confirmed #malware"
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
print(response.status_code)
print(response.json())
```

Make sure your API key is valid and that you have permission to add comments on that resource. If you run into any errors, the response body will usually contain a helpful error message.
